title: Plastic Man #1 DC February 2004 Kyle Baker Cover and Art On the Lam First Issue
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Plastic Man #1 (February 2004), DC Comics - first issue of Kyle Baker's Eisner-winning run. Story, art and cover by Kyle Baker. Direct sales, $2.95 cover price.

Back cover: WrestleMania XX Fleer trading cards ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
